notes: Every sector SVG is built from an approved presentation plan under docs/design/complex_v3/plans/sectors.

Metric scale and world position come ONLY from the approved overview plan of the same level: each entry pairs one rectangle of the sector plan (px) with the rectangle of the same room group on the overview plan (px).
Overview scale bars: upper and lower 135 px = 15 m (9 px/m); technical 80 px = 10 m (8 px/m).
World frame U/L: x = (ov_x - 990) / 9, z = (ov_y - 124) / 9. Upper and lower overviews share one pixel frame. Technical frame is anchored on the centre of the old stair (see levels.T).
Axes are scaled independently: the approved sector plans are not drawn at one uniform scale, so the anisotropy is reported instead of being hidden.
post_approval_ids are elements added to the approved plans by later agent work (stair pilots); they are not part of the approved plan and are dropped.
rect_overrides restore the approved size of elements changed in place by later stair-pilot work.
